# Data and domain rules

AGENTS.md A1–A3 and C3 apply.
Concrete names (endpoint registry, HTTP client, wrappers, codegen command) are in AGENTS.md → Project profile.

## Flow
`endpoint registry → HTTP client → Datasource → Repository → UseCase → Bloc/Cubit`

- D1 HARD: Endpoint URIs are defined only in the project's endpoint registry, one method per endpoint. Never build paths elsewhere.
- D2 HARD: Only datasources talk to the HTTP client, through the project's API wrapper. New code uses no other HTTP client (e.g. `http`, raw `Dio`).
- D3 HARD: Repository contracts live in `domain/repositories`, are abstract, and return `Future<Either<Failure, T>>`. Implementations in `data/repositories` wrap datasource calls with the project's exception wrapper and never touch the HTTP client.
- D4 SHOULD: A use case wraps one operation (`UseCase<T, Params>`, or `NoParams` when there are none). Orchestrating several repository calls belongs in a use case, not the Bloc.
- D5 SHOULD: Parameters use a dedicated immutable `<Verb><Feature>Params` class, not loose maps.

## API contracts and models
- D6 HARD: Build models only from a real response sample.
  - Keep fields nullable unless the API guarantees them.
  - Keep JSON keys with `@JsonKey(name:)`.
  - Never rename, drop or retype fields by guesswork.
- D7 SHOULD: Models are immutable, generated with the project's model tooling, and have a top-level `<name>FromJson(String)` parser like existing models. Run codegen after changes.
- D8 SHOULD: Take error envelopes and status codes from the backend contract. Extend the existing failure mapping instead of parsing errors ad hoc.

## Dependency injection
- D9 HARD: Register classes with the project's DI annotations, like neighboring code, and bind implementations to abstractions (`@Injectable(as: ItemsRepository)`). Never register annotated classes manually. Run codegen after annotation changes, and confirm the generated diff only adds the expected registrations.
- D10 SHOULD: Stateless services and clients are singletons. New screen-scoped Blocs/Cubits are factories (`@injectable`) unless the feature deliberately shares state.

## Hygiene
- D11 SHOULD: Datasources contain no business rules, formatting or UI concerns.
- D12 SHOULD: Log with the project's logger, never `print`. Never log tokens, auth headers or personal data.

## Naming
| Kind | Class | File |
|---|---|---|
| Model | `<Feature>Model` | `<feature>_model.dart` |
| Datasource | `Remote<Feature>Datasource`, `Remote<Feature>DatasourceImpl` | `<feature>_remote_datasource.dart` |
| Repository | `<Feature>Repository`, `<Feature>RepositoryImpl` | `<feature>_repository.dart`, `<feature>_repository_impl.dart` |
| Use case | `<Verb><Feature>Usecase`, `<Verb><Feature>Params` | `<verb>_<feature>_usecase.dart` |
| Bloc/Cubit | `<Feature>Bloc`, `<Verb><Feature>Event`, `<Feature>State` | `<feature>_bloc.dart` + `part` files for event and state |
| Screen | `<Feature>Screen` | `<feature>_screen.dart` |

Verbs: `Get`, `Create`, `Update`, `Delete`, `Submit`, `Upload`. Files are snake_case and match the class name.
